MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 8 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 19
   C. 12
   D. 11

2. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 41
   C. 40
   D. 3

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 24

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

5. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 13

7. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 81

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 17
   C. 21
   D. 15

10. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 0

11. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

12. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
